content.what_it_is: MATLAB comparison-plot script for the FUNWAVE-TVD spherical (lat-lon) conical island benchmark, case A. Same structure as the Cartesian car_conical_island scripts but with explicit model unit scaling: loads measured A.txt (L2; time + 4 gauge columns into t/measure, L12-16) and model stations sta_0001/0002/0008/0013 mapped to gauges 6/9/16/22 (L3-6). Parameters time_lag_case_A=24.4, scaleT=10.0, scaleS=100. (L8-10). Model curves: tmodel=data(:,1)/scaleT+time_lag (time in 0.1-s units divided by 10) and model=data(:,2)/scaleS (elevation in cm divided by 100 to m) for each station (L18-28). Gauge labels (L30-33); ax=[25 41 -0.02 0.04] (L34). 4-panel subplot loop (L36-49): measured blue solid vs model red dashed, title 'Gauge NN', ylabel eta (m), common axis, xlabel 'x (m)' on last panel (L46-48).
entities: script variables: data1 @L2, data6 @L3, data9 @L4, data16 @L5, data22 @L6, time_lag_case_A @L8, scaleT @L9, scaleS @L10, t @L12, measure @L13-16, tmodel/model @L18-28, gauge @L30-33, ax @L34, i @L37

equations.ref: time rescale (0.1-s units) and lag (same L21, L24, L27)
elevation cm to m (same L22, L25, L28)

calls: clear all @L1; load @L2-6; clf @L36; subplot @L38; plot @L39, @L41; hold on @L40; title @L42; ylabel @L43; grid @L44; axis @L45; xlabel @L47
unresolved: scaleT=10 and scaleS=100 (L9-10) imply this spherical run wrote station time in 0.1-s units and eta in cm (consistent with the 'blowup' *100 depth preprocessing in ../input/blowup_depth.f); the Cartesian twin scripts use no scaling -- unit convention external to this file.
time_lag_case_A=24.4 differs from the Cartesian case A lag 23.34; derivation not given.
xlabel 'x (m)' (L47) on a time axis -- same label error as the Cartesian scripts; station-to-gauge mapping is per comments L3-6 only.
